== Usage ==
The license value inserted when a contributor picks '''"CC BY-SA 4.0"''' from the Licensing dropdown on <code>Special:Upload</code>. Only use for original work the uploader created and is deliberately licensing under CC BY-SA — not for game screenshots.

The outer notice uses the <code>noexcerpt</code> class so maintenance/editorial
text is excluded from article excerpts and Page Previews.
